phrases.en: I didn't understand well. Could you repeat it?
Could you speak more slowly, please?
How do you say that in Spanish?

scenelets.notes: Using repair phrases in Spanish (not just switching to English) signals commitment and earns patience from interlocutors.

phrases.es: Es una cosa que sirve para...
No sé la palabra exacta, pero...
phrases.en: I don't know the exact word, but...

scenelets.notes: Circumlocution — talking around a word — is a core fluency skill. Practice it early.

phrases.es: Mi español no es muy bueno todavía.
phrases.en: My Spanish isn't very good yet.
Can you correct me if I make a mistake?

scenelets.notes: Asking to be corrected is rare and well-received. It signals genuine investment and usually produces a generous teacher.

register_map.key_insight: Repair phrases are not failure markers — they are fluency infrastructure. Knowing 5 repair phrases in Spanish extends your effective range 10x.
register_map.literary_note: Cortázar wrote characters who thrived in linguistic indeterminacy. The learner who masters repair is living that — navigating meaning in motion.
